architecture.route: POST /api/identity/bootstrap-owner; ALL applies disabled/dev/mutual-exclusion gates before downstream work.
architecture.normalRegistration: POST /api/identity/register remains unchanged; its server factory supplies no optional bootstrap policy hooks.
architecture.sharedLogic: Two optional handler hooks authorizeRequest and beforePasswordCheck; shared bounded parser, validation, abuse/work-slot controls, HIBP, Argon2id, canonical registration service/repository and neutral acknowledgement.

bindings.RIVER_IDENTITY_OWNER_BOOTSTRAP_ENABLED: Plaintext version variable; canonical/default false; only exact string true enables bootstrap.
bindings.RIVER_IDENTITY_OWNER_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN: Future protected Worker secret; no configured value in Git; 32-256 base64url characters with no whitespace. Future provisioning must use a randomly generated high-entropy token; syntax validation alone does not establish entropy.
bindings.RIVER_IDENTITY_OWNER_BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL: Future protected Worker secret; canonical credential email normalization; no configured value in Git.

architecture.mutualExclusion: Bootstrap unavailable whenever normal registration flag is exact string true.
architecture.authorization: Strict Authorization: Bearer header only. Web Crypto HMAC-SHA-256 import/sign/verify delegates signature comparison to the crypto implementation; no ordinary equality of supplied and configured secret strings.
architecture.emailPolicy: Normalized submitted email must equal normalized configured owner email; mismatch produces generic unavailable before COUNT/HIBP/hashing/persistence.
architecture.emptyStore: One COUNT-only SELECT through canonical RIVER_IDENTITY_DB batch; require successful singleton result, changes=0 and numeric counts exactly 0/0 before HIBP.
architecture.ordering: Closed/dev/invalid configuration and invalid IP fail before handler acquisition without database or external work. Activated handler checks method and canonical SITE Origin, verifies bearer, then checks content envelope, limiters and work-slot, reads bounded JSON, validates email/password, enforces owner email and empty store, checks HIBP, hashes and persists.
architecture.privacy: Generic denied responses; no secret/account/hash/principal-ID output, no logs, no CORS, no-store, no session/cookie creation.
architecture.administrator: Creates ordinary active principal only. No roles, first-account privilege inference, FOOD authority or administrator binding mutation.
architecture.login: Normal login/session creation is independent of registration/bootstrap flags; closing bootstrap preserves D1 identity and password credential.

schemaAndConcurrency.schema: migrations/identity/0001_river_identity.sql: principals.principal_id PRIMARY KEY; principal_password_credentials.principal_id PRIMARY KEY; email_normalized TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE.
schemaAndConcurrency.persistence: Existing D1IdentityRegistrationRepository uses one batch: plain principal INSERT, credential INSERT, joined readback. Runtime batch transaction rolls back principal insert when credential uniqueness fails; existing and new isolated Miniflare tests exercise this.
schemaAndConcurrency.ceiling: Concurrent bootstrap requests for the same configured normalized owner email can both observe 0/0 and pass HIBP, but UNIQUE(email_normalized) plus atomic batch commits at most one principal/credential pair. Concurrent loser can receive the same neutral202; acknowledgement is not individual creation proof.
schemaAndConcurrency.qualification: COUNT is a preflight, not a global database lock. Guarantee assumes enabled bootstrap versions use the same intended owner email, public registration remains closed, and no out-of-band identity writer races the operation. Independently enabled versions with different owner-email secrets or direct administrative writes require separate containment; not claimed safe by this schema.

versionUrlContainment: Reachable version URL/alias is not authorization. Requests still need canonical SITE Origin, private bearer, configured owner-email match and empty store. Ordinary same-origin version-URL browser form Origin does not match canonical SITE; future owner credential entry must preserve this policy.
